stem: Meena is sorting substances in her school science lab into 'metals' and 'non-metals'. She has four items on her bench: a piece of sulphur powder, an iron nail, a rubber eraser, and a copper wire. Which item should she place in neither group, because it is not an element at all?

teacher.key_rationale: Sulphur is a non-metal element, iron and copper are metal elements. Rubber is an everyday material (a compound/mixture), not an element, so it belongs in neither the metal nor the non-metal class.
